title: Maximum of a V on a closed interval
hints: The vertex is the only interior critical number.
Evaluate at 0, at the vertex and at the right endpoint.
Compare both endpoint distances to the vertex.
solution: The values are $[$a]$, $0$ and $2\cdot[$a]$, so the right endpoint attains the maximum.
statement:
